connector.name: Billium
connector.registryDescription: Official Billium MCP server: manage crypto invoices, payments, and webhooks from any MCP host.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the billiumhq account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BILLIUM_API_KEY
env.description: Secret API key (sk_...), from the dashboard under Settings → Developer → API keys.

env.name: BILLIUM_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (testing / staging environments).
